summary: Edge connection pool timeout leads to orphaned SSE stream coroutine and mid-generation silence
description: Issue summary: Customers reported SSE/chat streams that begin producing tokens but then stop sending any bytes for >30s without an explicit error. The client stays connected; no socket close is observed from the client side. Impact: multiple NoteHub users experienced mid-generation stalls that required them to cancel and resend prompts, impacting product UX and causing increased token replays. Environment: production us-east, dedicated cluster for NoteHub (tenant-id nh-894). Occurred 2026-03-09 22:12 - 23:45 UTC during a small traffic spike.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create a long-form chat request that triggers >1000 token generation using redwood-13b-v1 via SSE streaming API
2) Route through the customer's dedicated endpoint in us-east (note: route uses edge-proxy connection pooling to backend cluster)
3) Simulate intermittent 503 from one backend worker for ~200-400ms to trigger edge pool failover
4) Observe SSE stream: initial tokens arrive, then stream becomes silent for >30s while client socket remains ESTABLISHED
observed_behavior: Stream emits partial content and then stops sending further chunks without socket close or 5xx. Server-side worker logs show coroutine cancellation followed by no explicit release of the per-session KV cache. Edge logs show backend connection pooled socket timed out and was re-used. Retry/resume attempts from client sometimes result in duplicate session IDs and permanently paused generator coroutine on the worker node.
expected_behavior: If a backend connection is timed out or pooled away, the platform should either gracefully resume generation on an available worker or return an explicit error to the client so the SDK can retry. No worker coroutine should be left indefinitely paused holding KV cache/state.
logs: edge-proxy(us-east) WARN 2026-03-09T22:12:17Z connection_pool: idle timeout, reassigning socket to new request
edge-proxy(us-east) DEBUG 2026-03-09T22:12:20Z http2: pool_reuse socket_id=abc123 reused=true
metrics: token_latency_p50 increased from 120ms to 420ms during window
sse_stream_silence_count: 37 occurrences for tenant nh-894 between 22:00-23:00 UTC
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 03:15 - Support: validated customer reproduction with NoteHub engineer; captured pcap and SSE timeline.
2026-03-10 06:40 - SRE: correlated silence events with edge connection_pool idle_timeout log lines; hypothesized interaction between HTTP/2 pool reuse and in-flight streaming coroutines.

2026-03-10 09:20 - Runtime team: observed coroutine cancellation path that does not always run the full cleanup routine if cancellation originates from connection reset at the edge; KV cache lock can remain held leading to generator pause state.

2026-03-11 14:00 - Reproduced locally with controlled socket reset; confirmed that when edge reassigns a socket mid-stream, worker might transition to a 'paused' coroutine state if the resume handshake from edge is missing the session handshake header X-RW-Stream-Session.

Hypothesis: a) Edge pool re-use causes RST/timeout followed by reuse without performing full stream handshake; b) Runtime's stream-resume path assumes either full reconnect or full close; intermediate state leaves coroutine paused and does not emit heartbeat leading to silent stall.
comments: Alyssa Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Opened ticket after customer call. Attached client-side capture and timestamps. Customer reports 30-90s stalls where token generation resumes only after new request.
Diego Martinez (SRE) 2026-03-10: Initial triage suggests edge connection_pool config and runtime coroutine cancel path are involved. Escalating to runtime oncall.

Maya Gupta (Runtime Eng) 2026-03-11: Reproduced with harness. Adding instrumentation to mark session handed-off and ensure resume handshake includes X-RW-Stream-Session. Will push debug build to staging.
NoteHub Eng (customer) 2026-03-11: We're seeing this primarily during our peak ingestion where we have many concurrent long-chat streams. Happy to test changes in a staging mirror.
resolution_notes: Workaround (applied 2026-03-11): 1) Edge: increased connection_pool idle timeout from 10s to 45s for NoteHub tenant to reduce mid-stream socket reassignments. 2) Support: advised customer SDK to fallback to non-streaming (polling) for long jobs as short-term mitigation. Permanent fix (in progress): Runtime patch to ensure coroutine cancellation triggers full session cleanup and to make resume handshake idempotent. Edge change to ensure any socket handed to a new request performs a full stream-session handshake or returns 409 if session mismatch. Target PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1874. Follow-ups: automated test for socket-pool reuse + streaming, postmortem document and rollout plan.
